prerequisites.en: Unit Operations and basics of Chemical Process Technology (official prerequisite, GTU syllabus DI04005071)
prerequisites.gu: Unit Operations તથા Chemical Process Technology ના basics (સત્તાવાર prerequisite, GTU syllabus DI04005071)

title.gu: Petroleum તથા Refinery ના મૂળભૂત સિદ્ધાંતો

topics: 1.5 Refinery processes: 1.5.1 Physical Changes, 1.5.2 Chemical Changes
2.1 Primary treatment of crude: (a) Dehydration and Desalting, (b) Pipe still heaters
2.4 Physical properties of petroleum products and its measurements: (a) Petrol (b) Diesel (c) Kerosene (d) Lubricant oil (e) CNG and LPG (f) Grease
3.1 Cracking: purpose; effect of temperature and pressure; Thermal (Visbreaking, Delayed Coking, Fluid Coking), Catalytic, FCC, Hydrocracking; compare thermal and catalytic
4.1 Purposes and methods of sulfur removal
4.2 Methods: Doctor's sweetening, Catalytic desulfurization, MEROX treatment
4.3 Treatment of Kerosene by liquid SO2 extraction
4.6 Dewaxing: without solvent, with solvent (Ketone dewaxing)
5.3 C2 compounds: Vinyl chloride, Ethylene oxide
5.5 Chemicals from aromatics: Manufacture of LAB
